parameters.formDescription: The standard lane, ranked by score plus points for each week waited, with each part's reason. Change one part of one item: the change is logged with your name and reason, and the old value is kept.

parameters.query: select rank, request_id, title, status, score::float8 as score, weeks_waited, age_points::float8 as age_points, rank_points::float8 as rank_points, do_next, awaiting_confirmation from changedesk.standard_ranked order by rank;

select w.request_id, w.part, w.points, w.reason, w.set_by, w.is_change, w.previous_points from changedesk.score_working w join changedesk.standard_ranked r using (request_id) order by w.request_id, w.part;
